Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. We seek 1 Staff Engineer - Wafer Technology & Device Development (f/m/div) HRC1854022

Your role

You have already gained experience in semiconductor technology and device development and are looking for a career opportunity where you can develop new wafer technology and device concepts for automotive power applications? In this role, you will develop innovative concepts and approaches, optimize device geometry and process flows, and contribute to new automotive power technology platforms. If you enjoy working in cross-functional project teams and collaborating within an international environment, this is the right opportunity for you.

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Develop wafer technology and power device concepts for automotive applications

 * Take responsibility for the device throughout a complete development or test-chip learning cycle

 * Define process requirements and electrical test specifications

 * Assess reliability and dynamic device behavior beyond datasheet parameters

 * Develop test structures and coordinate physical and electrical failure analyses

 * Define and execute technical work packages independently across functions and sites

 * Build an expert network, share knowledge and identify intellectual property

 * Optimize device geometry and process flows using TCAD simulation, design and analysis of experiments, electrical measurements and statistical test-data analysis

With this position, you will enter our Technical Ladder - our career path for experts. You can focus deeply on technology and device development while continuing to advance your career. By expanding your expert knowledge, solving complex problems and sharing your insights across teams and locations, you will grow as a technical thought leader and help improve our technologies and products

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics or a related discipline

 * At least 3 years of professional experience in semiconductor technology, power device development and electrical data analysis, ideally including experience with a complete technology learning cycle and 3 years of foundry experience

 * Knowledge in TCAD device and process simulation

 * Experience in leading 8D problem-solving activities is an advantage

 * The ability to work independently toward agreed goals and contribute effectively within large project teams

 * Excellent English language skills; German is an advantage

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group G (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.
